subject: Horizon Analytics — Trial kickoff: calendar & environment checklist
messages:
From: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@horizon-analytics.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 13:15:00 +0000
Subject: Trial kickoff — need to confirm calendar + network checklist

Hey Ben + team,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. We'd like to lock in a 2-hour hands-on session the week of Dec 13 to run through prompts, routing, and a brief load test. Before we confirm the slot, a couple of technical items to sort:

- Sandbox accounts: can you create two sandbox orgs (dev + staging) for our engineers? We need separate API keys so we can simulate dev/staging traffic.
- VPC allowlist: our security team will only open egress to specific hostnames/IPs. Please provide the FQDNs and a CIDR list for your staging endpoints.
- Staging endpoints: what's the exact base URL for the session? We plan to run a routing demo that requires the redirect and fallback model endpoints.
- Load test window: we'll do a controlled ramp to 50 concurrent sessions. Any constraints on token-rate or recommended batch settings?

Prefer a morning slot (PST) — Dec 14 10:00–12:00 or Dec 15 09:00–11:00. If neither works, suggest alternatives.

Thanks,
Sam

--
Sam Tucker
Principal ML Engineer
Horizon Analytics
sam.tucker@horizon-analytics.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 15:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — need to confirm calendar + network checklist

Sam —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can do both sandbox orgs and will provision separate API keys scoped to the session. Quick plan:

1) Slot options: Dec 14 10:00–12:00 PST (preferred) or Dec 17 09:00–11:00 PST (alternate). Please confirm.
2) Staging endpoints & allowlist: attaching a short checklist + a CSV template for the IP/hostname allowlist. Key hostnames: staging-us.redwood-inference.prod, routing-us.redwood-inference.prod. We'll also include the CIDR ranges used by our regional egress.
3) Load test guidance: recommend burst ramp to 50 concurrent sessions with 200ms token latency expectation; use batching key=client_id to preserve routing behavior. We'll enable a temporary elevated qps profile for the window.
4) Prompt review: we'll allocate 30–45 mins for prompt walk-through and one example prompt evaluation to guard against regressions.

Attachments: redwood-staging-checklist.pdf, horizon-allowlist-template.csv

If that all looks good I'll provision sandboxes and send calendar invites.

Cheers,
Ben

--

Looping in a couple technical details from the runtime side that will help the load test and routing demo:

- Staging hostnames above are correct. We'll also publish short-lived API tokens in a secure Doc for your ops team and provide rotation steps after the session.
- For routing, please share the prompt types and expected session mix (chat vs. single-turn generation) so we can set model-variant fallbacks correctly.
- Load test metrics we'll collect: latency P50/P95, throughput (tokens/s), cache hit rate, and model-fallback count. We'll share a small dashboard link once the test starts.

Ben — can you provision the tokens and add the DocuSign link for the temporary NDA? Sam — if you can confirm expected session mix (e.g., 70% chat, 30% generation) we'll tailor the batch/kv settings.

– Jordan
